fields.features_heading: What a Pay per Call Page Needs
fields.features_subheading: The buyer pays for the call, not the visit. Describe the offer and its terms, and Emergent builds a page made for the phone.
fields.feature_1:
A number that dials on a phone

Emergent builds your tracking number into a tel: link in the header and again under the offer. On a cell phone, one tap on that link dials the number, with no digits to retype.
fields.feature_2:
One tracking number per page

Give each page the number the buyer or network assigned to that campaign. The page shows that number in every call button, and each call ties back to the page that drew it.
fields.feature_3:
Every tap saved as a row

The app saves each tap on a call button to a database you own, with the page, the button, the time, and the campaign tag from the ad link. Sort the rows by hour or by campaign.
fields.feature_4:
Call lengths from your tracker

Connect the call tracking tool you use over its API, and the app pulls each call's length next to the tap that started it. Calls past the buyer's minimum get marked billable.
fields.feature_5:
Hours that match the buyer's

Set the hours the buyer answers calls. Outside them, the page shows a short callback form in place of the call button, and the app emails each request to your dispatcher.
fields.feature_6:
The page as code you keep

Export the page and its tap log to your GitHub repository on paid plans. Or host it on Emergent under a custom domain, which uses credits, and change the copy by prompt.

plan.angle: The top 10 for pay per call landing pages is click-to-call tips, generic PPC landing page guides and beginner pay-per-call explainers: none shows what a publisher's page does with the number, the buyer's call terms and the hours a buyer answers. This page shows four publisher setups (a call-length log against the buyer's 90-second minimum, one page and tracking number per city, an after-hours callback form, and a headline test measured in call taps), each with the button, the rule and the row it lands in, and it sources the call-qualification facts from the call tracking vendor's own documentation.
tab_stories: Quillfen Media runs a furnace repair page for Columbus whose buyer pays for calls over 90 seconds; the app pulls each call's length from the call tracking tool over its API, and 131 of October's 214 calls ran past 90 seconds.

Tovenhall Leads runs one pest control page each for Tulsa, Wichita and Omaha, each with its own tracking number, and last week Wichita drew 58 of the 132 call taps, ahead of Tulsa at 41 and Omaha at 33.

Brisworth Plumbing Network answers from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.; outside those hours the page swaps the call button for a callback form, and the app emails each request to the dispatcher, Marit Vesterholt, at 7 a.m.; 22 came in overnight last week.
Ridgewane Roofing tests two headlines on a Denver page, each shown to 1,200 visitors: the hail damage headline drew 114 call taps, a 9.5% tap rate, against 72 taps, 6%, for the plain one.

domain_sources.claim: Pay-per-call is performance marketing where an advertiser pays publishers for quality calls (Invoca)
domain_sources.quote: Pay-per-call is a type of performance marketing where an advertiser pays publishers (also known as affiliates or distribution partners) for quality calls generated on the advertiser's behalf.

domain_sources.claim: Advertisers set the criteria that make a call commissionable, typically call length plus date, time and region (Invoca)
domain_sources.quote: Advertisers set the criteria that define if a call is commissionable. Typically this is based on the length of the phone call, in addition to other qualifying factors such as the date and time of the call, region of the call

domain_sources.claim: Unanswered calls or repeat calls do not typically qualify for commission (Invoca)
domain_sources.quote: Unanswered calls or repeat calls also do not typically qualify for commission.

domain_sources.quote: Each publisher or campaign is assigned a specific phone number. When a customer calls using that phone number, it is tied to the original source.
